items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: And Butler rap. Gaillet. Gaillet, yeah. He played the guitar. And I played the drum.

ctx.x: No, John Handy played saxophone and clarinet. Yeah, that's right. And the bass player, Sylvester.

But he played a while there with us. And also Duke Deconje played the piano. And Butler rap. Gaillet. Gaillet, yeah. He played the guitar. And I played the drum. Duke Deconje? Duke Deconje, yeah. He played the piano with us. Does he play any other instruments? No, he just played none of the piano. He got killed. You know he had a shoe shop there on Ramport near Common and he went out with this this fellow played the piano, Richardson they called him. Herbert Richardson, you know Herbert Richardson? No? Well he…
He must have had a different guitar player too after that. Yeah we did.

items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Me, René, Ducaugier, Ducaugier on piano, Butler rap, Gaillier they call guitar. Yeah. And Spurt on saxophone... That was his name, Eddie Handy?

ctx.x: Oh boy, it was something. It was pretty rough. Then I went to Budweiser dance hall in 35. Me and René went to that 35. Who was there at the Budweiser? Budweiser dance hall? Right there next to La Vida. You remember? Yeah, but I mean, who was with you? You had René? Me, René, Ducaugier, Ducaugier on piano, Butler rap, Gaillier they call guitar. Yeah. And Spurt on saxophone, played saxophone. Austin Young's brother? Austin Young's brother? Yeah, Austin Young's play trombone. Oh, he was there. And Eddie Handy played…
